args.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: an original Stitchin' Time iPhone Home Screen app-icon VARIANT, concept art only.
Edit the supplied image into ONE full-bleed OPAQUE 1024x1024 square PNG. All important subject matter is centered within the central 75-80%, with quiet background extending to all four edges. Do not add pre-rounded canvas corners, borders, card frames, mockups or typography.
Art direction: the game's crisp outlined pixel artwork. Chunky stair-step curves, clear silhouettes, near-black clinic-green outlines, 2-3 discrete shades per material, no smooth/vector edges, gradients, photographic texture, fine dithering or haze. Draw objects on roughly a 64x64 logical pixel grid; rooms can use 128x128 to retain furniture. Readable at 60x60.
COLOR is critical: use the lively actual bitmap-art material families and the owner's new direction: DEEP CLINIC GREEN #214e42, warm CREAM #f4e9cf, warm TEAL #367f88, cooler BLUE #6cafd0, wood BROWN #925b34 and #c98f6a, warm GOLD #dda94b, CORAL/RED-ORANGE #d95845 and #ef8266, ink #232720. Significant areas of warm or blue/teal color must remain plainly visible at small size. Do not desaturate to gray-green or monochrome. No muted gray wash or sepia filter. Preserve contrasting material colors rather than matching everything to the background. Do not print palette labels.
No people, faces, characters, animals, hands, blood, gore, clinical wounds, real brands, logos, Star of Life or red-cross emblems. No letters, words, numerals, labels, title, handwriting, watermark or pseudo-writing. Use clock ticks instead of numbers. A generic green/teal plus is allowed when specifically requested. Treat hearts as padded abstract shapes.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET. The earlier green-heart variant needs a single palette correction.
Primary request: change ONLY the padded heart's surface color from blue/teal to unmistakable rich DEEP CLINIC GREEN #214e42, with one middle green #326751 and dark green #183a30. The main shape must be green, not cyan, blue or teal. Replace the cyan highlight with a soft pale sage-green/cream highlight. Preserve the exact heart silhouette, heavy stepped near-black green outline, central seam, four GOLD single stitch bars and cream background. Preserve all composition, sewing details, pixels and warm gold stitch colors. No new props or text. Subject stays inside the central approximately 80% of the full-bleed opaque square.
